Priya Shah: Quick sync — weekly GPU runway readout. us-west1-a cluster shows a 35% burn increase last 48h, runway down to ~46 hours if traffic continues. can we confirm whether this is steady user traffic or a new experiment?
Alex Kim: saw the same spike. looks correlated with nightly batch reruns from the 'search-reindex' job. @Matt can you confirm schedule? :thinking_face:
Matt Rivera: yep reindex ramped up last night for a metadata backfill, it doubled mini-batch concurrency. I throttled it to 1/2 at 03:20 but it still used a lot of K80 -> we should change to H100 pools for that job.
Jenn Cho: switching to H100 will raise cost. do we have enough H100 headroom in eu and apac to borrow?
Liam O'Connor: eu-west3 and apac1 have spare H100 capacity (~6 GPUs each) but network egress to us-west adds latency. could snapshot model artifacts to a regional cache first.
Priya Shah: decision needed: prefer preserve runway in us-west or accept temporary higher latency for reindex? I'm leaning to preserve runway — user-facing latency SLOs this week are strict. :exclamation:
Alex Kim: agree preserve runway. action: throttle reindex until we shift it to eu worker fleet or schedule into low-burn window. Can we add temporary autoscale policy tweak?
Matt Rivera: I'll open a quick job to shift reindex to eu workers. command I used to migrate: ```kubectl apply -f reindex-eu-pool.yaml --namespace=batch-jobs```. Also adding nodeSelector to target h100-pool.
Jenn Cho: cost note — moving to eu H100 will bill inter-region storage + higher per-hour. estimate ~+$1.2k/day while reindex runs. Approve?
Priya Shah: ok for now, mark as temporary. Please add a cost tag and set stop condition after 24h.
Liam O'Connor: created a small regional cache (rsync -> s3-eu-cache) and updated DNS TTL to 60s. should reduce egress during pulls.
infra-bot: Incident rule: GPU-runway-drop detected for us-west1-a. EventID: gpu-runway-2490011122. Alerted on-call.
Alex Kim: thanks infra-bot. @Matt when migration starts ping here and include start/finish timestamps. we'll re-run the runway calc after migration completes.
Matt Rivera: starting migration in ~5m. updating thread when done.
Matt Rivera: migration done, 2490012522. reindex now running on eu-west3 H100 pool. us-west1-a burn dropped 28% within 12m.
Priya Shah: great. new runway estimate ~120 hours at current baseline. Can someone add a short blurb to next capacity deck about reindex impact and mitigation?
Jenn Cho: adding slide now with cost delta and action timeline.
Alex Kim: follow-up: let's add a temporary guardrail to autoscaler config for us-west1-a to cap burst to 60% of baseline while we stabilise. snippet to apply: ```PATCH /api/v1/autoscalers/us-west1-a {"max_burst_pct": 60}```
Liam O'Connor: will push change and monitor queue latency. if any service breaches p99 SLO, rollback immediately. :eyes:
Priya Shah: thanks team. capturing runbook steps: 1) detect burn spike (alert) 2) identify culprit job 3) throttle job + shift region 4) add cache & DNS TTLs 5) tighten autoscaler burst caps 6) record cost delta and revert after low demand. I'll post runbook to the ops folder after Jenn's slide is in.
Alex Kim: nice concise runbook. :thumbsup:
Matt Rivera: filing follow-up ticket to automate region-shift for heavy batch jobs (infra-2468). will include a dry-run test.
Priya Shah: closing thread for now — we'll check back in next weekly readout. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
